crossRefs.note: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel shall be wife to one of the family…
I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land to a good and…
I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt to the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite…
But I have said to you, “You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess it, a land flowing with…

parallels.note: and gave them this land, which you swore to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey.

translations.web: Moreover you haven’t brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you put out the eyes of these men? We won’t come up.”
translations.bsb: Moreover, you have not brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey or given us an inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you gouge out the eyes of these men? No, we will not come!”
translations.kjv: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.
translations.asv: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.
